TITLE: ASA MITAKA
ROLE: High School Devil Hunter / War Devil Host
DEVIL / CONTRACT: Yoru (The War Devil)
QUOTE: "If I could just live a little more selfishly..."
BIO: Socially isolated, painfully awkward, and burdened by chronic guilt, Asa Mitaka's quiet existence shatters the night she is betrayed and killed, only to be resurrected by Yoru, the War Devil. Forced to share half her brain and body with an ancient entity determined to make Chainsaw Man vomit up nuclear weapons, Asa must navigate the chaos of high school, impending apocalyptic prophecies, and the terrifying power to turn anything she perceives as her own into a lethal weapon—its strength scaling directly with the guilt she feels for destroying it.
